verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Unreal's Editor and Blueprints visual scripting exist and are used for level-related testing (unreal-docs-1, unreal-docs-9) and community notes the editor UI persists across versions (unreal-comm-13), but none of the pack explicitly documents the viewport, inspector/details panel, or prefab/scene-composition workflows that define the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of viewport navigation, inspector/details panel, prefab/Blueprint-actor scene composition, and hands-on technical-artist testimony that this is the primary level-building workflow.
